title: MoneyNeverSleeps (Pete Townsend) — Eric: 'The more golden the goose, the greater the temptation to butcher it.'
summary: Pete Townsend — Norio Ventures GP and Techstars MD Emeritus, who used The Lean Startup as required reading for portfolio founders — drops a special double-length MoneyNeverSleeps episode covering the Long-Term Benefit Trust, the 100-year-old Danish insulin company protecting $500B in shareholder value, and the one two-page filing most founders never make.
blockquote: The more golden the goose, the greater the temptation to butcher it.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on MoneyNeverSleeps (quoted by Pete Townsend on X)
attribution_title: Podcast hosted by Pete Townsend (GP, Norio Ventures; MD Emeritus, Techstars)
